item.title: “A lot of players from the core team,” Arshdeep Singh opens up on India’s plan to win at least 5 ICC trophies in next 10 years
item.description: Team India have achieved unprecedented success in recent ICC white-ball tournaments, winning 30 of their last 32 completed matches. item.description: SunRisers Leeds' X account was suspended on Thursday (March 12), hours after they picked Pakistan spinner Abrar Ahmed during The Hundred auction. item.description: Sanju Samson had an amazing redemption in the T20 World Cup 2026 as he finished as the highest run-getter for the Indian team despite playing only five games. item.title: “We all cried,” Mahmudullah recalls Bangladesh players breaking down after losing to India by one-run during T20 World Cup 2016
item.description: During the T20 World Cup 2016, MS Dhoni's spectacular run-out helped India snatch a victory from the jaws of defeat against Bangladesh at Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru. The Tigers needed one run to draw the game and two runs to win on the last ball of the final over, but Dhoni’s brilliance left them heartbroken. item.description: Team India stars Sanju Samson and Jasprit Bumrah have received overwhelmingly top ratings, as legendary ex-Australian captain Ricky Ponting rated the top performers of the recently concluded T20 World Cup 2026.
